nodes.long_description:
Hold a knife.

Julienne cucumber, carrot, and bell pepper.

Wet the rice paper in water.

Place the ingredients on the rice paper.

Wrap the filling with the rice paper.

Repeat once more.
nodes.short_description: Experience the art of fresh spring roll making in VR. Julienne vibrant veggies, place them on delicate rice paper, and roll to perfection. Develop your skills through interactive, repetitive practice designed for fun and mastery.
